description: Shared planner vectors. Each case starts from an idle timer and applies its steps in order. A step is an action taken at time `at` (Unix ms). `expect` is either the next stored timer state (every field) plus the session records that finished, or an error `invalid:<code>` / `rejected:<code>` (the state then stays as it was). Settings are `defaults` with the case's overrides. Rust (crates/core/tests/planner_vectors.rs) is the source of truth and wrote the expectations (run it with UPDATE_VECTORS=1); TypeScript (web/src/lib/planner.test.ts) must produce the same.
